2249: 	if pollInterval <= 0 {

2252: 
2253: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(pollInterval)
2254: 	go func() {
2255: 		defer ticker.Stop()
2256: 		for {
2257: 			select {
2258: 			case <-s.ctx.Done():
2259: 				return
2260: 			case <-ticker.C:
2261: 				batch, err := s.rollupService.BuildNextBatch(s.ctx)
2262: 				if err != nil {
